title: error_report.decided
description: The regulatory team decided an error report (error_report.submitted): confirmed, naming the rule version that corrects the reported one (a published or draft version with a corrects relation to it; its publication replaces the reported version and reaches the affected businesses through the rule events), or rejected with the analyst's notes. The obligation service's group obligation.error-decisions records the decision on the tenant's report. Producer: rulebook. Consumers: obligation.

report_id.description: The report decided, as error_report.submitted named it.

rule_version_id.description: The rule version the report was about.

outcome.description: confirmed: the error is real and a correcting version fixes it; rejected: the rule version stands.

notes.description: What the analyst said about the decision; empty when they said nothing.

correcting_rule_version_id.description: For a confirmed report, the rule version with a corrects relation to the reported one; null for a rejection.
